newsitem.title: USA: BVR Technologies adopts spinoff plan.
newsitem.headline: BVR Technologies adopts spinoff plan.

text.p: BVR Technologies Ltd said on Monday that its directors had decided to implement a spin-off plan that anticipates the transferral of its core businesses to a new publicly traded company.
Specifically, the transaction will affect BVR's development and manufacture of training systems for the aircraft industry, the company said in a statement.
BVR said said it expects to conclude the deal in the first quarter of 1998.
